goal: Run Kimi coding tasks through the current ACP runtime while preserving a local-first, approval-aware web research loop with structured source evidence.
description: The native macOS workbench must keep a stable ACP session transport, map structured runtime events into the desktop audit stream, and expose verifiable web research evidence without leaking credentials or page bodies.
tasks: negotiate ACP over stdio and create or resume a session
stream assistant and tool updates into the desktop event protocol
bridge ACP permission requests to explicit desktop decisions
capture WebSearch and FetchURL evidence as structured sources
record local-only research usage without secrets or page bodies
safety_requirements: No provider key or full fetched page body in audit records
